info.title: Universal Agent workflow server
info.description: Save workflows, register agents and workspaces, start and follow runs, answer gates, talk to the chief, cancel, and read artifacts, intermediate data and agent conversations. The server binds to loopback by default and has no authentication of its own.

tags.name: Workflows
tags.description: Saved workflow definitions, their canvas layout and remembered workspace bindings.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Agent profiles (engine, charter, rules, skills) steps delegate to, and the engines installed here.

tags.name: Workspaces
tags.description: Directories runs work in, bound to workflow slots.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Start, follow, steer, cancel and inspect runs: their log, artifacts, intermediate data and agent conversations.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Recorded agent sessions, also usable on their own.

put.summary: Save a new version of a workflow
put.description: The definition id must match the path. The body is validated as a WorkflowDefinition.

put.summary: Remember the workspace each slot runs in
put.description: Workspace id per slot, used when a run names none.

post.summary: Install the sample agents and workflow

get.summary: List registered agents with their versions

post.description: Versions are immutable: registering the same id and version again with a different profile fails with 409.

post.summary: Register a directory as a workspace

get.summary: Agent engines on this machine, with their models and effort levels

post.description: Workspaces maps slots to workspace ids (see /api/workspaces); slots left out use the bindings remembered for the workflow. The run executes in the background; follow it with /api/runs/{id}/stream.

get.description: Server-Sent Events. `log` events carry one RunLogEntry each (`id` = its seq; fold them with the SDK's `applyRunLogEntry`); `activity` events carry `{ active, chiefAnswering, liveProgress }`. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` or `?after=<seq>`.

post.description: Steps still executing are aborted and their results dropped; the run ends CANCELLED. A finished run is returned unchanged.

post.summary: Answer a gate decision or an agent question

post.description: Returns once the message is recorded. The reply arrives in the run log as a `chief.intervened` event; while steps execute, retries and reruns it asks for wait until they finish.

get.description: What steps stored with `ua-workflow data …` or the `data_*` MCP tools, oldest first.

get.summary: Problems still open in a run
get.description: What each review's latest round left (a loop's last round speaks for it; a PASS can carry minor findings) and the issues steps logged (`ua-workflow issue`, `log_issue`), most severe first. What a closing step hands over to a person.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Bytes to read (default 64 KiB, at most 1 MiB)

post.summary: Start a conversation with an agent

WorkflowRecord.description: A saved workflow: its latest definition, canvas layout and remembered workspace bindings.

RunState.description: A run folded from its log: status, outputs, every scope (loop rounds and parallel items included) with its node states, attempts, assessments, context manifests, open waits, chief state and events.

revision.description: Sequence number of the last log entry folded in.

scopes.description: Scope state by scope key, e.g. `$root`, `$root/fix__loop:round_1`, `$root/pages[2]`.

attempts.description: Node attempts by attempt id (produced artifacts, assessment, workspace changes, error).

assessments.description: Verdicts (PASS, NEEDS_FIX, FAIL, BLOCKED) with findings, by assessment id.

manifests.description: What each agent attempt was given, by manifest id.

waitRequests.description: Gate decisions and agent questions, by request id.

active.description: This server is executing the run right now.

Conversation.description: A recorded agent conversation (ACP session) and its state.

source.description: Left by a review, or logged by a step.

details.description: Other fields the step logged with the issue.
